generic_domain.justification: The term 'planning' is the most general as it serves as a foundational concept that can encompass all specific planning strategies and methods, including those dealing with uncertainty and model inaccuracies. It acts as an umbrella domain that includes various specialized areas like 'planning under model uncertainty' and 'planning with uncertainty'. These more specific domains focus on particular aspects of the planning process but are fundamentally subsets of the broader 'planning' domain.
